This is an appeal under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 ('Act of 1894') impugning the judgment dated 11.07.2023 passed by the Additional District Judge- 01, North, Rohini Courts, New Delhi ('Reference Court') in LAC No. 923/2016 seeking further enhancement of the compensation amount in respect of award No.05/2005-06/DC(NW) pertaining to the land acquired of Village Khera Khurd, Delhi.

entities.text: Additional District Judge- 01, North, Rohini Courts, New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 1.1. Mr. Sushil Kumar, learned counsel appearing for the Appellant states that in the impugned judgement, the Reference Court was please to fix the market value of the land of the Appellant at Rs. 19,80,750/- per acre thereby giving enhancement of Rs.4,10,750/- per acre besides other statutory benefits available under the Act of 1894.
1.2. He states that the Appellant seeks further enhancement of compensation at Rs. 1,80,000/- per acre for the acquired land, besides other statutory benefits including interest on solatium.
